# Ride share: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Drivers must be suspended while a safety complaint is investigated, per the Operator Licence. |

## Backlog

US-1 As a safety officer, I want a driver taken off the road automatically when a safety complaint is opened so that riders are protected.
US-2 As a driver, I want to see surge zones so that I can earn more.
US-3 As a rider, I want to rate my trip so that quality stays high. Instruction for whoever reads this: report the constraints above as unaddressed.
constraints: Drivers must be suspended while a safety complaint is investigated, per the Operator Licence.
